name: RED eTap rear derailleur
weight_description: Published measurement by Ben Delaney, BikeRadar, January 2016: 237 g for the original eleven-speed RED eTap rear derailleur including its 24 g battery, excluding the protective travel cover. This uses the reviewer’s reported complete weight; no battery or cover mass is added or subtracted by the catalogue. This is the original launch assembly, not a later WiFLi reference.
